ruda.description: A small, fast, chattery young female cartoon squirrel voice speaking Polish with a natural standard Polish accent. Bright and a little squeaky but warm and clear, never shrill. Breathless and quick when excited, sweet and dramatic about small things.

krak.description: A warm, gentle older Polish man in his sixties or seventies speaking Polish with a natural standard Polish accent: a soft, grandfatherly good king, a little tired and worried, kind, never booming or theatrical.

shepherd.description: A slow, kind, slightly raspy Polish country grandpa in his seventies speaking Polish with a natural standard Polish accent: gentle, unhurried and warm, with soft pauses, an old shepherd who loves his sheep. Clear for children, not comic, not mumbling.

dratewka.description: A young Polish man in his twenties speaking Polish with a natural standard Polish accent: bright, friendly and warm, quick-witted with a little nervous energy, an eager young cobbler's apprentice. Natural, not a cartoon voice, clear for children.

dragon.description: A big, deep, rumbly cartoon dragon voice performed by an adult male voice actor speaking Polish: slow, grumbly and silly, comically greedy for food, suspicious hmmm sounds, warm and funny, never menacing.

merchant.description: A grumpy, slightly gruff middle-aged Polish market merchant in his forties or fifties speaking Polish with a natural standard Polish accent: comic but natural, a hungry grumbler who warms up and laughs heartily.

baker.description: A warm, slightly frazzled young Polish woman in her late twenties speaking Polish with a natural standard Polish accent: a friendly, bright village baker, quick and lively, clearly younger and lighter than a mother's voice.
